submissions.note:
The global peak phase is `kal_bulk_step4` (pair2-forward bulk Kaliski step), the
SOLE binder at 2310 (phases affine_combined_breg_unred and bk_bulk_step4 are at
2309). In `kaliski_iteration_bulk_prefix3` the per-iteration ancilla `f1` was a
constant |1> qubit whose only use was the STEP-5 measurement-uncompute
`cz_if(f1, b_f, sm)`. Since f1 is identically |1>, that CZ equals a single-qubit
`Z` conditioned on the measured bit: `z_if(b_f, sm)` (already present in builder.rs
but unused in the bulk path). Replacing `cz_if(f1, b_f, sm)` with `z_if(b_f, sm)`
and removing the const-|1> f1 alloc/x/free eliminates the one transient qubit that
was live across the binding STEP 4, dropping that phase 2310 -> 2309. Toffoli is
unchanged (f1 carried no Toffoli; z_if is a Clifford Z). Applied to both the
forward `kaliski_iteration_bulk_prefix3` and the backward mirror.

- disable the low-q final apply chunk: `DIALOG_GCD_APPLY_FINAL_LOWQ=0`

- disable the final windowed-fast split: `DIALOG_GCD_APPLY_FINAL_WINDOWED_FAST_BLOCKS=0`

- spend part of the recovered Toffoli budget on GCD convergence: `DIALOG_GCD_ACTIVE_ITERATIONS=262`

- re-hunt the fixed-length identity tail: `DIALOG_TAIL_NONCE=2432`
